name: obsidian-vault-sync
description: Standalone macOS desktop application to sync Obsidian vault from Android to Mac over USB
author: Antigravity

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && npm run build:plugin
scripts.package: npm run build && npx electron-packager . "Obsidian Sync" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --icon=icon.icns --out=release-builds --overwrite --ignore="^/(src|electron|release-builds|tsconfig\\.json|vite\\.config\\.ts|create_icon\\.sh|icon\\.png|\\.git|\\.vscode|test\\.iconset|icon\\.iconset)"
